nodes.text: Run proton NMR spectra to gather structural information
NMR pattern suggests CH3, CH2, CH aliphatic chain plus aromatic system; possibly diphenyl propane-like structure

support.quote: The integration pattern (3H + 2H + 1H + 4H = 10H total) and the aromatic signal at 7.46 ppm for 4H suggests possibly two phenyl groups.

nodes.text: Run carbon NMR to confirm structure
13C NMR shows two aromatic quaternary carbons, symmetric aromatic CH carbons, and an ethyl group pattern; consistent with two phenyl groups

support.quote: 139.25, 134.60 ppm - aromatic carbons (likely quaternary or ipso carbons)

nodes.text: Run mass spectrometry to determine molecular weight and formula
Mass spectrum: base peak at m/z 233.96, also 231.97 (77%) and 235.96 (24%)
Run IR spectra to identify functional groups
Isotope pattern with ~1:1 peaks at m/z 232 and 234 suggests possible bromine atom, but IR and NMR are inconsistent with this

support.quote: The isotope pattern with peaks at ~232, ~234, and ~236 with the relative intensities suggests the presence of a bromine atom

nodes.text: IR: C-H stretches (aromatic and aliphatic) at 3109-2954 cm-1, aromatic C=C at 1588, 1577, 1502 cm-1; no carbonyl or heteroatom peaks
IR confirms pure hydrocarbon with no carbonyl, O-H, or N-H groups

support.quote: No carbonyl peak (~1700 cm-1), no O-H or N-H broad peaks. This confirms it's a hydrocarbon.

nodes.text: Run HSQC NMR to correlate C and H shifts
HSQC confirms only 4 aromatic H, an ethyl group, and a CH; total 10H; structure must have limited aromatic substitution

support.quote: So we have 4 aromatic H total (2H at 128.3 ppm and 2H at 129.0 ppm).
